$comment: Shared location schema for deep links. Both surfaces (static 8080 and the React workstation) load this file; their parsers must agree exactly. Contract: guidelines/35-linked-views.md. Values below are illustrative fixtures, not product data.

parameters.name: project
parameters.crossProject: never switches silently; StateNotice with Switch armed and Stay

parameters.name: addr
parameters.carries: address or cursor in the inspected build
parameters.requires: build; without it the builds containing the address are listed

parameters.name: ws
parameters.history: push; consecutive switches with no Go collapse

parameters.name: panel
parameters.carries: full corpus view inside a workspace; target of every Show all

describes.report: the recovery report: VariantLedger, rebuild comparisons, readiness and divergence reports
describes.atlas: project intelligence (F19): function discovery and index, dependency and neighborhood exploration, prioritization
describes.review: the match review queue, cursor in page
describes.builds: the builds of the project with their inventory and binding state
describes.pipeline: the PipelineMap and its live views, focused by node
describes.readiness: the readiness × coverage matrix of entities × builds (ReadinessMatrix)
describes.names: name and type provenance for every field of the selection, across builds (NameProvenance)
describes.reuse: existing recovered analysis and receipts found for a build, before any new work
describes.runtime: runtime capabilities of a build, one row per entity (RuntimeCapabilities)
describes.outputs: every export, output and result by artifact × build, with status, claim tier, basis and the 8080 observation (OutputsCatalog; ws=evidence); artifact= opens its ArtifactCard
describes.toolchain: compiler, linker and flag facts × builds, each value with its evidence level, plus the pinned rebuild toolchain (ToolchainEvidence; ws=evidence)
describes.variants: how each pair of builds relates: toolchain differences and entity counts by variance class, with a drill-down (VariantRelation; ws=compare, cmp selects the pair)
describes.analysis: each build's analyzer configuration and one-shot analyzers, read-only until Run in the ActionStrip (AnalyzerPanel); with build
describes.scripts: the script manager, transcript, interpreter and bundles, shown only when Advanced is on in View settings (ScriptConsole); with build for the bound session
describes.versions: Ghidra Server version control per build: version, checkout state, history (VersionControlPanel); with build
describes.history: one build's program transactions with Undo, Redo and Undo to here as confirmed catalog verbs (EditHistory); with build

parameters.name: views
parameters.history: replace; never rewritten at narrow widths

parameters.name: layers
parameters.carries: annotation layers over the code wells (view state in the URL, like views)
parameters.history: replace; never rewritten at narrow widths

parameters.name: artifact
parameters.grammar: artifact-id from the served outputs inventory
parameters.unresolved: Artifact ‹id› is not in this project's outputs inventory

parameters.name: hold
parameters.overflow: extra entries become keep entries, with a notice
parameters.history: replace; Back/Forward never open, close or re-point holds

parameters.name: keep
parameters.carries: Kept cards in the evidence rail
parameters.requires: build, except for the build-independent kinds entity and node
parameters.overflow: refused with 'Three cards kept; release one'; nothing is evicted

parameters.name: dock
parameters.carries: dock tab (the five tabs of guideline 30)

parameters.name: f
parameters.history: replace when typed or edited and when a chip is removed; push when applied from a link, which is a Go (for example Changed by a3f9 or Show all)

parameters.name: page
parameters.refuse: a score-shaped value is refused by name

kinds.$comment: One kind list shared by hold and keep. A component that needs a new kind adds it here first.

describes.artifact: an ArtifactCard (keep=artifact:‹id›[~basis]); corpus-scoped, so the build is optional
describes.type: a type or field layout at one build (keep=type:CacheEntry.name_len@build-b)
describes.walk: a PointerWalk chain at one build (hold or keep)
describes.frame: a FrameLayout for one entity at one build (keep=frame:‹entity›@‹build›)
describes.vtable: a VTableBrowser class at one build (hold)
describes.xform: a TransformTimeline for one entity and cmp pair (hold)

filterAxes.$comment: The shared f= axis vocabulary. A component that needs a new axis adds it here first. An unknown axis stays verbatim in the URL and gets a StateNotice.

axes.carries: a line of the focused job's log
rows a job's receipts recorded as changed; never changed_by
merge results by record kind and result
one of the seven facts by state
the References section mode: refs, calls or slots
problems and jobs under one pipeline node
artifacts by artifact status: delivered, partial, stale, future, never-run, no-report, reference
whether a stored file with its hash is recorded: yes or no
claim tier: verified, advisory, hint, bytes; a never-produced artifact has no tier
observed on 8080: yes or no; a separate axis from artifact status
entities of the cmp pair whose stored comparison result has this variance class (VariantRelation drill; requires cmp): compile, entropy, source, unknown
compiler annotations by kind (CompilerLayer, TransformTimeline): inline, icf, gs, eh, seh, div, tail, switch, fpo, ilt, hotpatch, strpool, loop, intrinsic, cc; a comma list selects several
annotations, steps, slots or items by difference class: compile, entropy, source, unknown; identical is not a value
MatchExplain rows by class: regalloc, schedule, stack, reloc, constant, branch, inline, toolchain, source
annotations whose presence varies across builds

aliasRules: A canonical name wins over its alias; an ignored alias is named in a notice.
A parameter a surface cannot render stays verbatim in its URL and gets a StateNotice (lossless round trip).

legacyWindows.$comment: Documented window=wb-* values (docs/plans/2026-08-31-2245-feat-workbench-one-page-functions-plan.md, dogfood reports). `region` names the region that receives focus on landing; it is not the `focus` alias, which maps to addr. Mappings are proposed and not verified against the static window registry.

/dashboard/explorer.note: Explorer is the Navigator region, never a center surface

push: Go (link, row Enter or click, go-to pick, Make primary, job or receipt link, Show all)
stopStores: viewport as anchor address plus caret
focus as region + component + row key

intercept.only: same-origin anchors whose href parses fully under this schema and alias table
